page.title: Components
page.lead: The core fundamentals and compounds in AlignUI's look, on one page: grouped by kind and by AlignUI's own categories, each shown in its modes, sizes and states.

groups.title: Fundamentals
groups.intro: The single controls everything else is built from.

categories.title: Actions
categories.intro: Buttons and menus that start something.

examples.title: Button
examples.description: Primary for the main action, neutral for a strong second one, stroke for the rest, ghost inside toolbars, error for what can't be undone.

examples.title: Button sizes
examples.description: Medium is the default; small, extra small and the smallest for dense rows.

examples.title: Compact button
examples.description: An icon before the words, icon-only buttons named by a tooltip, and a button while its action runs.

examples.title: Link button
examples.description: An action that reads as a link, and a link that goes somewhere.

examples.title: Button group
examples.description: Related buttons joined into one control.

examples.title: Dropdown
examples.description: A menu of actions, with icons, shortcuts and a separated group.

categories.title: Form
categories.intro: Everything a person types, picks or switches.

examples.title: Input
examples.description: A labelled field, with an icon when it searches.

examples.title: Input states
examples.description: Disabled, and an error with its hint under the field.

examples.title: Textarea
examples.description: Longer text over several lines.

examples.title: Select
examples.description: One choice from a short list.

examples.title: Checkbox
examples.description: Checked, unchecked, mixed and disabled.

examples.title: Radio
examples.description: One choice from a few, all visible.

examples.title: Switch
examples.description: A setting that applies at once.

examples.title: Slider
examples.description: One value, or a range between two.

examples.title: Datepicker
examples.description: A date typed or picked from the calendar.

categories.title: Displaying Data
categories.intro: Small pieces that show who, what and how far.

examples.title: Avatar
examples.description: Sizes from 24 to 48, with presence, and a group that folds the rest into a count.

examples.title: Badge
examples.description: Filled and lighter pills in each colour, and a count.

examples.title: Status badge
examples.description: A state with its dot, on a bordered chip.

examples.title: Tag
examples.description: Filters that turn on and off, and a tag that can be removed.

examples.title: Kbd
examples.description: A keyboard shortcut.

examples.title: Progress bar
examples.description: How far something has got, with its share in words.

examples.title: Rating
examples.description: A score to choose, and an average to read.

examples.title: Tooltip
examples.description: A name or a hint shown on hover and focus.

categories.title: Layout
categories.intro: Switching between views of the same thing.

examples.title: Segmented control
examples.description: One of a few views, as words or icons.

groups.title: Compounds
groups.intro: Fundamentals composed into larger pieces with their own behaviour.

examples.title: Alert
examples.description: Information, success, warning and error, with an action when there's a fix.

examples.title: Toast
examples.description: A short message that goes by itself; errors stay until closed.

categories.title: Layout
categories.intro: Sections that fold, and the way back up.

examples.title: Accordion
examples.description: Sections that open one at a time.

examples.title: Breadcrumb
examples.description: Where this page sits, with a link to each level.

examples.title: Tab menu horizontal
examples.description: Views of one thing, over a line.

examples.title: Tab menu vertical
examples.description: The same views, stacked at the side.

examples.title: Pagination
examples.description: Pages of results, with the ends always in reach.

categories.title: Overlays
categories.intro: Panels that open over the page.

examples.title: Modal
examples.description: A focused task that blocks the page until it's done or cancelled.

examples.title: Drawer
examples.description: Settings that slide in from the edge.

examples.title: Popover
examples.description: A small form anchored to its button.

categories.title: Displaying Data
categories.intro: Rows of records and the files that come with them.

examples.title: Table
examples.description: Records in rows, with people, roles and their state.

examples.title: File upload
examples.description: Choose or drop files, and follow each one's progress.

words.q1: Can I change my plan later?
words.a1: Yes. Switch plans from Billing at any time; the change applies from the next cycle.
words.a2: Only the members you invite, unless you share a public link.
words.q3: How do I export my data?
words.a3: Open Settings, then Export, and pick the format you need.
